listing.name: Kameo RePowered
listing.summary: Explore Kameo RePowered and follow the upstream project for requirements, downloads and setup.

steps.title: Keep a lawful completed native copy
steps.instruction: Use an already lawfully prepared working Windows x64 kameorepowered.exe copy with its complete adjacent dependencies and the original creating data/profile. The tagged README grants MIT for host-side source/build/CI but expressly says recompiled generated game code and linked built binaries are not redistributable. Published releases or old matching digests do not override that exclusion. Fresh package acquisition remains held pending an applicable attributable permission/asset-clean route; this is not a blanket private-execution prohibition.

steps.title: Finish original-file and edition setup upstream
steps.instruction: Use your own Kameo: Elements of Power Xbox 360 original, upstream documented USA extracted assets/default.xex, and complete existing extracted data. Keep vanilla and title-update builds distinct, with matching lawful update/DLC packages and actual extracted roots. Portcove does not extract an ISO/STFS package, install a title update, generate code or validate an exact disc/XEX hash. Do not infer foreign-revision, DLC, save or vanilla/TU interchangeability.

steps.title: Select the game with its established roots
steps.instruction: Select kameorepowered.exe itself, with the actual writable installation-root initial CWD. For the tagged pinned-SDK interface, review --game_data_root and the absolute existing assets directory as two literal arguments. Preserve the creating --update_data_root and its absolute extracted update path when that TU copy requires it, plus any established --user_data_root and --cache_root choices, each followed by its separate absolute path token. Keep spaces inside each path token. Do not choose scripts/run.py, an extractor, Goopie or a build/helper entry. Registration itself does not prepare or launch anything; retain an already working build-specific launch context rather than inventing a profile.

steps.title: Review intent and keep replacement upstream-owned
steps.instruction: Review and consent to the exact native executable, actual initial working directory and literal arguments; choose Play separately. Portcove tracks the selected process; it does not prevent other instances or restrict the game’s file access. Upstream/player owns original extraction, setup, repair and actual replacement. Close all real instances before changing files, retain the old creating copy and review a changed executable through relink. Removing registration removes only metadata and preserves external bytes.

steps.title: Preserve the actual runtime, originals and user profile
steps.instruction: Keep the complete runtime/original/asset/update/DLC roots and kameorepowered.toml, all actual user/save/content/cache/log/mod/custom paths and unknown files. The reviewed SDK uses the Windows known Documents folder plus kameorepowered by default (Documents may be redirected), including Xbox-style 0000000000000000/4D5307D2/00000002 DLC content; explicit root choices override defaults. Preserve any custom roots separately. Keep variant-specific state with its creating copy; do not move or regenerate state merely to register.

warnings: The selected v0.2.1 tag and current source differ. Its .sdk-version pins f22cd9dc, while a manifest also names 0.8.1; source/SDK review is not a source-to-binary certificate. The tagged pinned runtime requires game_data_root despite the abbreviated README zero-argument placement example. Only a completed already working copy with its actual supported arguments is offered.

New downloads remain paused because upstream explicitly excludes built game code from redistribution. This is a specific permission condition; an absent optional licence file is a separate fact. Portcove does not download, prepare, install, update, back up, roll back, migrate or delete this copy, or authenticate its original files.

Portcove has not run a new game package or original files, or tested save/load, gameplay or installed behavior. Earlier Windows title-update v0.2.1 file-integrity results apply only to that exact package, and do not cover vanilla or other builds.

listing.download_block_reason: New downloads are waiting for an applicable attributable permission covering the selected linked recompiled binary/package. Upstream expressly excludes redistribution of generated game code and built binaries that link it; host-side MIT and old matching package bytes do not override that condition. Reconsider a reviewed permitted or asset-clean package route; lawful existing private copies remain a separate use question.

decisions.rationale: The repository moved from birabittoh to MaxDeadBear. GitHub only lets an administrator of the original repository transfer it, and birabittoh authored its history and remains a contributor. Keep the Portcove identity and listing; only its project location changes.
